# 3ds_rom_tool

[← Command index](README.md)

Convert, trim, untrim, extract or inspect Nintendo 3DS CIA and CCI (.3ds) files.

## Synopsis

```
3ds_rom_tool [options]
```

## Description

Finds every `.cia` and `.3ds` file under the input path (or takes the one file given)
and applies the chosen action to each file it fits. Output is written next to the
source file, and the source is left in place.

`-a` converts each CIA to a CCI and `-b` converts each CCI to a CIA, both with
CtrMakeRom. `-t` trims each `<name>.3ds` into `<name>.trim.3ds`, and `-u` restores each
`<name>.trim.3ds` to its full size as `<name>.3ds`, both with 3DSRomTool working on a
temporary copy. `-e` unpacks each CIA with CtrTool into a `<name>` folder holding the
certificate chain, ticket and TMD (`00000000.cer`, `.tik`, `.tmd`) and the content
files as `.app` files. `-n` prints CtrTool's description of every CIA and CCI.

## Options

### General

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `-i, --input_path <input_path>` | A `.cia` or `.3ds` file, or a directory searched recursively for them; must exist. |

### Actions

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `-a, --cia_to_cci` | Convert each CIA to a CCI written next to it. |
| `-b, --cci_to_cia` | Convert each `<name>.3ds` CCI to `<name>.cia`. |
| `-t, --trim_cci` | Trim each `<name>.3ds` CCI into `<name>.trim.3ds`. |
| `-u, --untrim_cci` | Restore each `<name>.trim.3ds` to full size as `<name>.3ds`. |
| `-e, --extract_cia` | Unpack each `<name>.cia` into a `<name>` folder next to it. |
| `-n, --info` | Print CtrTool's information for every CIA and CCI. |

### Common options

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `-v, --verbose` | Enable verbose mode. |
| `-p, --pretend_run` | Do a pretend run with no permanent changes. |
| `-x, --exit_on_failure` | Enable exit on failure mode. |
| `--no-preview` | Skip the preview confirmation prompt. |

## Examples

### Trim every CCI in a folder

```bash
3ds_rom_tool -i /path/to/3ds -t
```

### Preview the trim without changing anything

```bash
3ds_rom_tool -i /path/to/3ds -t -p -v
```

### Restore trimmed CCIs to full size

```bash
3ds_rom_tool -i /path/to/3ds -u
```

### Convert a CIA to a CCI

```bash
3ds_rom_tool -i "/path/to/Game (USA).cia" -a
```

### Unpack every CIA into a folder of its own

```bash
3ds_rom_tool -i /path/to/3ds -e --no-preview
```

### Print the header information of every 3DS file

```bash
3ds_rom_tool -i /path/to/3ds -n
```

## Notes

- Give one action. When several are given, each file gets the first one in the order `-a`, `-b`, `-t`, `-u`, `-e`, `-n` that fits its type.
- Files already named `.trim.3ds` are not trimmed again by `-t`.
- CtrMakeRom, 3DSRomTool and CtrTool must be installed as JoyBox tools.
